_comment: Real Dilithium3-signed sample mandate bundles for the offline verifier. Generated by `cargo run --example dump_mandate_bundle`. Each bundle is self-verified against mandate_bundle::evaluate_mandate_bundle before emit. The 'scoped' sample is the committed scope-deferred vector (examples/verify/mandate-bundle-scope-deferred.json): a NON-wildcard mandate (allowed_ops:[commit]) whose act is CONSISTENT anyway — v0 records scope, never checks it (scope_deferred: true).
